exposure: Knowledge of infant-related obesity risks during pregnancy
Knowledge of maternal-related obesity risks during pregnancy
Knowledge of IOM gestational weight gain (GWG) recommendations
outcome: Likelihood of adhering to IOM GWG recommendations
cohort: 159 healthy pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy, predominantly African American (57%) and from low socioeconomic conditions
finding: Knowledge of GWG recommendations was associated with lower total GWG in normal and underweight women, while knowledge of infant-related obesity risks was associated with higher GWG in overweight and obese women.
